description: Run-level budget-sensitivity results for final no-early BP-Enh at requested slack 0.05, 0.10, and 0.20.
scope_note: Positive allowance levels are included here; alpha=0 reuses BP-Enh records in summary_comp.json.

instance_metadata_reference.usage: Instance fingerprints, structural fields, and baseline budgets only; no prior solver outcome is imported.

field_definitions.instance_fingerprint: Size and FNV-1a content fingerprint from the solver; used to identify matching inputs.
field_definitions.instance_family: Original instance family: arb, at, buckets, po, or rt.
field_definitions.relation_type: arbitrary for arb; transitive for at, buckets, po, and rt.
field_definitions.stack_budget: Permitted number of occupied stacks at this sensitivity level.
field_definitions.placement_density: Off-diagonal zeros in conflict_matrix divided by n_items*(n_items-1).
field_definitions.density_class: Low when density <= 0.15; Medium when 0.15 < density <= 0.30; High otherwise.
field_definitions.algorithm: Canonical machine-readable method identifier in the final comparison.
field_definitions.method_label: Short method label used in manuscript tables.
field_definitions.source_algorithm: Original algorithm identifier; all runs here use bp-enhanced without early branching.
field_definitions.source_build_id: Build identifier of the original result; builds are intentionally retained rather than pooled anonymously.
field_definitions.source_result: Original result path relative to D:/branch-and-price/Release/results.
field_definitions.source_result_sha256: SHA-256 digest of the original result JSON.
field_definitions.has_solution: Whether the run returned an incumbent.
field_definitions.solution_valid: Whether the returned incumbent passed validation.
field_definitions.objective: Best feasible objective (blocking items) when available.
field_definitions.normalized_gap: Gap as a fraction in [0,1], not a percentage; null when unavailable.
field_definitions.gap_status: Source status of the gap calculation.
field_definitions.solving_time: Elapsed solver time in seconds; all runs, including time limits, are retained.
field_definitions.initial_objective: Objective of the constructed initial solution when available.
field_definitions.initial_used_stacks: Occupied stacks in the constructed initial layout when available.
field_definitions.used_stacks: Occupied stacks in the returned solution when available.
field_definitions.source_settings_fingerprint: Source configuration fingerprint, retained for provenance.
field_definitions.result_consistent: Consistency check recorded by the merge procedure.
field_definitions.objective_consistent: Objective consistency check recorded by the merge procedure.
field_definitions.baseline_stack_budget: Original stack budget before the sensitivity increase.
field_definitions.requested_budget_slack: Requested relative increase in the stack budget (fraction, not percent).
field_definitions.effective_budget_slack: Actual relative budget increase after rounding and capping (fraction, not percent).

null_policy: JSON null and empty CSV cells mean unavailable; neither zero nor 100% is imputed.
